text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having concluded the Classic Triple Crown 
season, Meisho Doto safely made it through 
her goals.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just then, tragic news arrived. Her 
classmate Admire Vega was stepping down. 
Due to leg inflammation, there was no 
telling when she might return...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
T.M. Opera O lamented that there was 
nothing to do but wait. Meanwhile, Meisho 
Doto, who had been protected by the two of 
them and stayed meek all this time—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her eyes are finally open. To become a 
strong Umamusume who can protect Opera O 
on the Gâ stage, she decided to first 
enter the "Nikkei Shinshun Hai" at the 
start of the year.
